intent: When the tester made a run's instance swap, it carries the swap's copy of that run's own log directory (logs/tester/0/runs/<test>/) into the live run_dir(test)/sealed/ before the swap is removed, so whatever any device wrote there during the run survives the seal. The tester names only its own run dir, never a device's file.
request: bdd46aec0789: a sealed run's own log directory survives the swap in cairn/devices/tester/device.py (home cairn/devices/tester)
